prompt: We've finished the grill. We're adding JWT authentication to an Express API. Approach: a middleware function that extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header, verifies it using the app secret, and attaches the decoded user to req.user. If valid, calls next(). Files: src/middleware/auth.ts (create), src/types/express.d.ts (update — augment Request with user field), src/routes/index.ts (update — apply middleware to protected routes). Edge cases: missing Authorization header → 401 with 'No token', malformed token → 401 with 'Invalid token', expired token → 401 with 'Token expired', valid token → next() with user on req. Let's break this into tickets.

assertions.text: Type augmentation ticket comes before or is combined with the middleware ticket (types are a dependency)
Routes wiring ticket comes last (depends on middleware existing)
Acceptance criteria include all four edge cases: missing header, malformed token, expired token, valid token
Asks engineer for sign-off before starting Ticket 1
